svg.aria-label: Six radar charts, one per upscaler, each with 10 spokes; on every spoke the best of the six reaches the outer ring and the others reach in proportion to it, so a larger shape is better and a dent is a weakness. The lossy2 DLL comes first, and its shape is the dashed outline in the other five. Still picture and moving background, mean: accuracy (dB): FSR 4.1.1 47.58 dB, Lossy2 46.80 dB, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 47.03 dB, FSR 3.1 45.02 dB, HelixSR 2.0 45.27 dB, XeSS 45.54 dB. Thin railing in motion: accuracy (dB): FSR 4.1.1 41.61 dB, Lossy2 40.79 dB, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 40.95 dB, FSR 3.1 38.95 dB, HelixSR 2.0 39.86 dB, XeSS 39.56 dB. Areas a moving object has just uncovered, mean of a panning and a still camera: accuracy (dB): FSR 4.1.1 32.91 dB, Lossy2 34.49 dB, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 33.52 dB, FSR 3.1 30.25 dB, HelixSR 2.0 29.63 dB, XeSS 32.31 dB. Old image beside a moving object, mean of seven scenes: error (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 1.92, Lossy2 2.15, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 2.52, FSR 3.1 3.20, HelixSR 2.0 3.63, XeSS 4.84. Thin bars fixed on screen in front of a panning background, mean of four pans: error where their old image lands (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 0.82, Lossy2 0.87, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 1.28, FSR 3.1 1.04, HelixSR 2.0 2.98, XeSS 3.85. Tiny fast sparks: share of their brightness shown (%): FSR 4.1.1 83%, Lossy2 73%, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 76%, FSR 3.1 40%, HelixSR 2.0 79%, XeSS 50%. Leaves swaying without motion vectors, mean of three sway speeds: error (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 11.0, Lossy2 12.3, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 10.0, FSR 3.1 16.7, HelixSR 2.0 14.2, XeSS 14.3. Still picture: change per frame (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 0.037, Lossy2 0.025, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 0.029, FSR 3.1 0.014, HelixSR 2.0 0.022, XeSS 0.084. Thin wire under a slow pan: how close its brightness is to the true one (%): FSR 4.1.1 90.5%, Lossy2 67.2%, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 62.1%, FSR 3.1 90.2%, HelixSR 2.0 79.7%, XeSS 81.0%. Time per upscale call, mean of 1080p, 1440p and 4K output (ms): FSR 4.1.1 2.70 ms, Lossy2 1.32 ms, FSR 4.1.2 Lite 1.21 ms, FSR 3.1 0.71 ms, HelixSR 2.0 1.12 ms, XeSS 2.90 ms.
svg.text: The shape of each upscaler: 10 measures
On every spoke the best of the six reaches the outer ring. Bigger is better; a dent is a weakness. Dashed: the lossy2 DLL.
old image of things fixed on screen
brightness close to the true one
A spoke at half length: twice the error (or the change per frame, or the time) of the best of the six; for sparks, half as much shown.
Orange: this project's lossy2 DLL (release dll-2026-10-19; frame skipping, it changes the picture). FSR 4.1.2 Lite: AMD's small model,
run in this project's test harness (not AMD's runtime). Test rig, 4K output, one card, single runs.
